bidirectional_value_propagation.definition: Temporally ordered causal effects between participants including a return to an earlier participant whose value may be positive, zero, or negative.

capability_unlock.definition: An intervention enables a previously inaccessible future capability or feasible action with value derived from nonduplicated counterfactual effects.

counterfactual_baseline.definition: Explicit feasible reference trajectory used to determine incremental value; it may include waiting or no intervention when feasible.

decision_boundary.definition: Conditions under which the preferred evaluated action changes, not a prediction that the conditions will occur.

decision_relevant_information_value.definition: Expected improvement in achievable decision utility due to additional evidence, distinct from information gain for its own sake.

future_effect_identity.definition: Stable causal identity of a material incremental future state delta within a time-indexed scenario; independently realized recurrence requires distinct period episode identities, whereas mutually exclusive scenario branches may reference the same underlying effect without adding their values together.

future_work_elimination.definition: Causally supported future labor or repeated effort avoided relative to a feasible baseline, booked once per underlying state delta.

strategic_value.definition: Expected net objective-relative utility of an admissible action under a declared DecisionModel, baseline, horizon, compatible units and uncertainty, including mutually exclusive, exhaustively reconciled immediate, future, direct-cost, expected-risk-loss and opportunity-cost effects. Separately subtract only costs and losses not already embedded in net utility flows; evaluation is not authority.

strategic_value_assessment.definition: Evidence- and revision-bound quantitative comparison of admissible alternatives under a declared objective and compatible utility unit that preserves uncertainty and separates forecast from realization.

systemic_future_value.definition: Expected counterfactual change in future reachable utility caused by an intervention relative to an explicit feasible baseline, excluding immediate and already-booked changes, evaluated with a bounded, question-appropriate numerical method, including discounted scenario expectations when applicable, with evidence-based uncertainty and stopping controls.

value_propagation_mesh.definition: Bounded branching, reconvergent or feedback topology whose shared state deltas are valued once with explicit causation, attribution and stopping controls.
